customManagers.description: Swift releases. swiftlang/swift tags them swift-X.Y.Z-RELEASE. Version and commit are captured by ONE regex so Renovate moves them together -- verify-relocatable.sh asserts the clone of SWIFT_TAG is exactly SWIFT_SHA, so a version bumped without its commit fails closed.
The swiftlang/llvm-project commit the build support is cut from. Branch and digest captured together so the branch stays authoritative in pins.env rather than duplicated here.

packageRules.description: A PATCH Swift bump is self-contained: the tag and download URL derive from SWIFT_VERSION, SWIFT_SHA moves with it, and the .pkg is verified by signer identity. Takes the family default (ship-if-green).

EXCEPTION to the family ship-if-green default. A MINOR or MAJOR Swift bump is not self-contained: LLVM_BRANCH must move to the llvm-project branch cut for the new release (swift/release/<minor> through 6.3, swift/release/<X.Y.Z> from 6.4), which no regex here can infer. Left alone it builds Swift <new> against the <old> LLVM build support -- it would BUILD FINE AND BE WRONG, which is exactly what a green build cannot catch. Needs a human.
